Your daughter.|Lexo Sooger and the [[Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion|Countess]]|}} '''Lexo Sooger''' was a [[Dor Namethian]] [[Gender|male]] who was the star [[masseur]] at [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]] in [[Canto Bight]]. Sooger used to be an [[Assassin]]. ==Background== Lexo Sooger was born into poverty and raised in the slave pits of [[Askkto-Fen IV]] tending to [[Gladiator|fighting slaves]] in the steam baths until he was purchased by a merchant who saw his potential as a masseuse. He eventually settled on [[Cantonica]] becoming a [[masseur]] at [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]] in [[Canto Bight]]. One night he found a female [[human]] baby in a cargo container in an alley and took her in. Unable to find her parents, Lexo adopted the child calling her [[Lula Sooger|Lula]]. Despite his initial dislike of humans and initial lack of knowledge on caring for one, Lexo raised her with love and care and the two had a deep bond with Lexo affectionately calling Lula his "azure sea". The two lived in sparse conditions in living quarters below Canto Bight. He was sought by the [[gangster]] [[Sturg Ganna]], who eventually kidnapped Lula. Lexo called in several favors and utilized many of his former skills as an assassin to find and rescue her. Eventually Lexo infiltrated Sturg's home and found Lula, he also found incriminating evidence on Sturg to blackmail him into leaving him and Lula alone from now on. He also got Sturg to pay for Lula to take [[Fathier]]-riding lessons. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Lexo Sooger first appeared deleted scenes of the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].{{Film|VIII}} {{Del}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Lexo Sooger}} *{{StoryCite|story=Rules of the Game|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)|audiobook=1}} {{Mo}} *{{StoryCite|story=Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)|audiobook=1}} {{1st}} *{{Film|VIII}} {{Del}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} ==Sources== *{{StarWarsShow|jEBgOF8AjFI|Kelly Marie Tran's The Last Jedi Prank and Google Home's Star Wars Trivia BTS|sw_url=video/kelly-marie-tran-s-the-last-jedi-prank-and-behind-the-scenes-of-google-home-s-star-wars-trivia-challenge}} {{1stp}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-10-aliens-you-should-know-from-star-wars-the-last-jedis-canto-bight|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 10 Aliens You Should Know from Star Wars: The Last Jedi's Canto Bight}} *{{InsiderCite|181|Launchpad}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |cs=Lexo Sooger |ja=レクソー・スーガー |ka=ლექსო სუგერი |pl=Lexo Sooger }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Sooger, Lexo}} [[Category:Assassins]] [[Category:Dor Namethians]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Masseurs]]
